subject.title: Architecture: reduce import coupling in pi-embedded-runner/attempt.ts (50+ imports) and discord monitor (30 imports)

question: Should this tracker be narrowed to the remaining Discord monitor decomposition, with embedded-attempt cleanup owned by the RuntimePlan roadmap?
rationale: Current evidence shows meaningful overlap but not equivalence: the merged and planned agent work does not choose the Discord context and ownership boundaries.

options.title: Narrow to Discord
options.body: Keep this issue for typed Discord preflight/process/provider boundaries and direct further embedded-attempt work to the RuntimePlan roadmap.

options.title: Split trackers
options.body: Create a dedicated Discord architectural issue and close or retitle this umbrella tracker once links preserve the existing context.

options.title: Keep combined
options.body: Retain both areas in one staged roadmap, accepting broader ownership and sequencing coordination.

recommendation.title: Narrow to Discord
recommendation.body: Keep this issue for typed Discord preflight/process/provider boundaries and direct further embedded-attempt work to the RuntimePlan roadmap.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged work and the prior issue review make this the strongest available routing signal.
